run_metadata.coverage_summary: All source tiers were attempted (Tier 1 Commonwealth + all states/territories; Tier 2 councils/GBEs/universities/health; Tier 3 private-sector e-sourcing hubs and major-buyer portals; plus a source-discovery sweep). Connectivity was re-tested at the start of the run: WebFetch returned EGRESS_BLOCKED for every host, including a neutral control fetch to en.wikipedia.org, confirming a session-wide organisation egress block rather than a portal login wall (same condition as the 2026-09-30 run). WebSearch still works (it routes through the Anthropic API, not the egress proxy) and surfaced candidate opportunities and source leads, but the spec's fidelity rule requires every detail to come from the actual notice or its documents. Because no notice page could be opened, no opportunity could be verified, so this run records ZERO tenders and ZERO confirmed new sources. Every source lead surfaced by WebSearch this run (East Gippsland / Forbes / Hinchinbrook councils on VendorPanel, etc.) was already discovered in earlier runs, so there is nothing genuinely new to add. Candidate opportunities and any noteworthy landscape changes are preserved in gaps / recommended_seed_additions for a future unblocked run. No data was invented.
gaps: CRITICAL BLOCKER (recurring): Outbound HTTPS page fetching is blocked for this session. WebFetch returns {"error_type":"EGRESS_BLOCKED"} for all hosts and a direct control fetch to https://en.wikipedia.org also failed, proving a session-wide (organisation egress allowlist) block, not a portal-specific wall. Proxy status (/root/.ccr/__agentproxy/status) shows enabled=true, bundleCoversEveryHost=true and recentRelayFailures=[], consistent with a deny-by-default allowlist that permits only infrastructure hosts (Anthropic API, npm, pypi, crates, go, gcloud/gh) and no external tender domains. Per the proxy README a 403/EGRESS_BLOCKED must be reported, not retried or routed around.

Tier 2 (councils/GBEs/universities/health) — VendorPanel public tenders, individual council sites, Sydney Water / Melbourne Water / SA Water, CSIRO procurement, university and Local Health District tender pages — all EGRESS_BLOCKED.

Tier 3 (private sector/construction) — service.ariba.com (SAP Ariba Discovery), BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue/Woodside/Santos supplier portals, Woolworths Partner Hub, Coles/Wesfarmers supplier pages, Qantas (Coupa), CBA/Westpac/NAB/ANZ, Telstra/Optus/TPG, AGL/Origin, EstimateOne, ICN Gateway — all EGRESS_BLOCKED. Invitation-only consultancy RFPs remain out of scope by definition; registration/login-gated corporate RFx could not be recorded because even the public portal landing pages were unreachable. No corporate tenders were invented.

LANDSCAPE NOTE (unverified, WebSearch-only): search snippets indicate an SAP Ariba Business Network -> Coupa migration wave affecting some Australian buyers, with Ariba being phased down through March 2026. Confirm the current e-sourcing platform for affected buyers (which portal to register on) once egress is restored before relying on it.

UNVERIFIED CANDIDATE OPPORTUNITIES (surfaced by WebSearch only; NOT fetched, NOT recorded as tenders; several likely stale/closed by 2026-10-01 and must be confirmed on the notice page before use): DFAT/Palladium Quad Infrastructure Fellowship RFTs (RFT26-002/003/005) were published early Sep 2026 with 13 Sep 2026 close dates and appear CLOSED; carry-over candidates from prior runs (Tasmania aged-care greenfield EOI ~closes 6 Nov; Melbourne Water Field Services Panel RFT ~closes 27 Oct; Australia Post OTC Services EOI ~closes 14 Oct; various NT QTOL and Brisbane City Council items ~closing mid-late Oct) could not be re-verified this run. Treat all as leads, not confirmed opportunities.

No new source could be confirmed because none could be fetched.

RECOMMENDATION TO RESTORE COVERAGE: add the tender-portal domains to this environment's egress allowlist (or run the routine where WebFetch is permitted). Until then daily runs can only produce empty, honest results because no notice can be verified.
